title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor

Scope of Services

This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.

1. Project Overview

Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective's countries and programs as required.

The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.

2. Scope of Services and Deliverables

The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.

A. Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)

  • Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective

  • Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification

  • Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil

  • Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners
    Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives

B. Grant making process support (approximately 40%)

  • Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil

  • Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos

  • Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria

  • Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team

  • Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation

C. Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)

  • Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes

  • Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use

  • Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders

3. Term and Time Commitment

The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.

The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.

Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.

4. Collaboration and Communications

The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.

5. Performance and Deliverables

Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:

  • Grant making documents produced

  • Proposal reviews and written assessments completed

  • Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered

  • Contributions to process improvement and learning

Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.

6. Fees and Payment

Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.

Contractor Skills / Requirements

  • Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English

  • Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone

  • Ability to commit for six months

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.
You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.
What You'll Do
Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.
The Technology Stack
Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clustrers (when scale requires)
Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
Language: Python w/ Polars), SQL.
Qualifications
The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
Quality Obsessive: You don't just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.
Must Haves
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
Strong SQL and Python skills.
Advanced English communication skills.
Good To Have
Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

description:

Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 5 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work. Para que você possa entender melhor, vamos falar como somos:
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Como Analista Sênior de Experiência Digital no time Acadêmico, você terá a chance de participar de um time dinâmico e diversificado, que tem o foco em entregar a melhor experiência de aprendizagem, a melhor formação de professores e os melhores conteúdos. E nada disso é possível se não estiver orientado pelos dados e pelas evidências.
Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver conteúdo e soluções inovadoras para o desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de alunos.
Liderar a conceituação e criação de metodologias e materiais pedagógicos de alta qualidade, assim como das features dos produtos.
Supervisionar a implementação de iniciativas da jornada de aprendizagem do aluno.
Acompanhar o orçamento dos projetos da área, garantindo eficiência e retorno sobre investimento.
Apoiar operacionalização de iniciativas e acompanhar processos de mensuração de aprendizagem.
Facilitar a comunicação entre a equipe de Student XP e todos os stakeholders relevantes.
Requisitos e qualificações
Quais são as Habilidades e Competências exigidas para essa posição?
Hard skills:
Gestão de projetos: Liderança na concepção e execução de projetos relevantes, focados em transformar a experiência do aluno de forma abrangente, desde a captação até a retenção.
Implementação de metodologias de experiência: Habilidades para a implementação de frameworks de UX design e design thinking, aplicando essas metodologias para criar soluções inovadoras que impactam a jornada do aluno de forma positiva.
Desenho de experiências inovadoras: Habilidade em criar e liderar o desenvolvimento de experiências únicas e inovadoras para os alunos, garantindo um diferencial competitivo no mercado educacional e aumentando o engajamento e a retenção.
Análise avançada de dados e feedbacks: Competência em liderar análises aprofundadas de dados de satisfação, engajamento e performance dos alunos, utilizando essas informações para guiar decisões estratégicas e otimizar as jornadas e produtos.
Inovações estratégicas: Capacidade de liderar mudanças e inovações no design da experiência do aluno, garantindo que a empresa esteja à frente das tendências educacionais e que as interações sejam impactantes e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.
Soft skills:
Liderança: Inspirar e orientar a equipe para atingir metas estratégicas.
Visão Holística: Integrar conhecimentos e práticas para aprimorar o desenvolvimento estudantil.

A Helloo desenvolve e opera soluções de mídia digital out of home em diferentes ambientes, como elevadores residenciais, shopping centers e aeroportos. A empresa atende tanto grandes anunciantes quanto pequenos e médios empreendedores, utilizando dados comportamentais obtidos em seus pontos de presença para segmentar campanhas com maior precisão. Além disso, a helloo mantém uma operação dedicada à criação de experiências interativas em elevadores e espaços comerciais.

• Domínio das principais ferramentas de criação e edição (Adobe Creative Cloud completa).

SOBRE NÓS
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas".
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.
Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?
Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar

description:

Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Uniforms Senior Manager is responsible for the planning and operational delivery of the corporate FIFA27 Business Casual uniform as well as the FWWC2027 Tournament Dedicated and FIFA Formal uniform programmes in line with the overall FIFA Uniform Strategy and the approved usage and entitlement matrix.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Responsible for full project management and implementation of the FWWC2027 uniform programme including issuance operations that support both workforce and volunteers
Ensure all FIFA27 workforce have uniform according to the entitlement and usage matrix
Effectively collaborate with key FIFA Zurich and FIFA27 stakeholders including Workforce Planning, Volunteer Management, Host City Management, Logistics, Accreditation and Partnership Rights Delivery
Create strategy, process and flows for the full project plan for FWWC2027 uniform programme capturing risks and mitigations throughout
Develop the operational plan, setting up affiliated systems, identify functional distribution spaces, engage with stakeholders, contract local suppliers to deliver the FWWC2027 uniform programme, across all the Uniforms Distribution Centers
Oversee FIFA27 uniform budget, including creating accurate forecasts for each FIFA27 related event e.g. FWWC2027 Draw
Manage relationships with external uniform suppliers that may be required, ensuring compliance in line with Framework Agreement and enforcing contractual obligations
Recruit and effectively train and manage the uniforms team (both workforce and volunteers) during planning and delivery periods ensuring best practices are clearly defined and the service level provided across all Uniform Distribution Centers is consistent
Manage stock levels and keep up-to-date records of each uniform item during pre-tournament (e.g. Business Casual uniform/ formal items that may be required for side events) and tournament time.
Communicate the agreed FIFA27 Uniform Guidelines and Usage Policy at each FIFA tournament and event
Ensure the uniform guidelines are upheld and enforced across all client groups including FIFA Formal Uniform eligibility
Plan uniform distribution to all related FWW2027 additional events, e.g. Final Draw,
Work with relevant FIFA27 stakeholders to agree and provide guidelines to Suppliers who are not entitled to Tournament Dedicated Uniforms Other duties as necessary to ensure the smooth running of the FWWC2027 Uniform operations.
YOUR PROFILE
Qualifications and Experience
Minimum experience of 3 years in Uniform Management; preferably with experience in mega (sports) events and corporate organisations
Excellent people manager, motivating, inspiring and seeing results through others
Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
Strong IT skill including MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)
Strong written and oral communication
Proven track record in administering uniform projects across complex quantity structures
Team Player, willing to work to tight timelines
Positive attitude, patience and persistence, with a pragmatic approach to solving problems
Excellent time management skills and ability to balance competing priorities
Demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service
Requirements
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

's Government Business Development team enables nations and public institutions to manage risk faster than the speed of weather.

As VP, Government Business Development LATAM, you will own and scale 's government business across your region. You will be accountable for closing and expanding multi-year public-sector contracts, building a durable regional pipeline, and serving as the senior company representative to government stakeholders, partners, and international institutions. In addition, you will be responsible for leading and developing the regional government sales team, initially managing a small team and scaling it over time with full accountability for the performance, professional growth, and domain expertise of all sales personnel operating in the region.
This role combines regional market leadership with hands-on execution. You will lead the region's largest and most complex government opportunities while building the foundation for repeatable growth across priority sectors.
What you'll do:
Own the regional government business, including pipeline development, deal execution, and revenue delivery across priority sectors.
Lead the end-to-end sales cycle for complex public-sector engagements, from opportunity shaping and market entry through procurement, contracting, and expansion.
Build and maintain senior relationships with ministries, regulators, agencies, and state-owned entities relevant to priority use cases.
Shape and influence government programs aligned with national priorities, modernization efforts, resilience planning, and operational readiness.
Lead and oversee RFPs, tenders, and multi-stakeholder programs, including donor- or IFI-funded initiatives where relevant (e.g., World Bank, ADB, AfDB, IDB, USAID, JICA, etc.).
Build and manage a regional partner ecosystem, including systems integrators, local firms, international organizations, and strategic collaborators.
Work cross-functionally with product, solutions engineering, legal, finance, and delivery teams to tailor offerings and ensure successful contract execution.
Maintain a realistic, budget-aligned pipeline and provide accurate forecasting to executive leadership.
Strategically leverage executive involvement, including the founder/CSO, while independently driving deals to closure.
Represent at high-level government forums, industry events, and international conferences.
Travel up to 30% domestically and internationally as required.
What you bring:
Fluency in English, additional languages relevant to the region are a strong plus.
15+ years of experience in government, institutional, or enterprise sales, with significant responsibility for complex, multi-year public-sector deals.
Proven track record of closing large-scale government contracts, ideally in SaaS, data, infrastructure, or technology-driven solutions.
Strong understanding of public procurement, budget cycles, and the realities of navigating multi-stakeholder government environments.
Demonstrated experience managing formal tenders and RFPs, and comfort operating in regulated environments.
Demonstrated prior management experience, including leading regional sales teams, setting performance expectations, coaching senior sellers, and driving consistent execution across complex, distributed environments.
Ability to operate credibly with senior government officials and political stakeholders, strong judgment, and diplomacy.
Strong pipeline discipline and forecasting accuracy, able to distinguish political interest from funded opportunity.
Experience building and leading teams and partner ecosystems in-region.
Comfortable operating in a startup environment, combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution.
Self-directed, accountable, and mission-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and bias toward action.

title: Oficial Gasista|Hidráulico
description:
Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro.
Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado(a) futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.
Na Smart Hospital, acreditamos que a diversidade nos torna mais fortes. Nossas oportunidades são abertas a todos os talentos, com foco total na inclusão de pessoa com deficiência PCD e reabilitados pelo INSS.
Quem somos?
Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.
O que buscamos?
Um profissional experiente e dedicado para integrar nossa equipe como Bombeiro Hidráulico Gasista. O profissional será responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de tubulações de água, esgoto e, principalmente, de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, interpretando projetos e garantindo a segurança e a conformidade técnica das instalações.
Dia a Dia
Instalação e reparo de tubulações de água (fria e quente) e esgoto sanitário.
Montagem, construção e manutenção de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, conforme projetos.
Interpretação de projetos hidráulicos, sanitários e de gás para a correta implantação dos sistemas.
Realização de reparos em canos, vazamentos, sistemas hidráulicos e desobstrução de tubulações e ralos.
Montagem, instalação e manutenção de aquecedores, aparelhos a gás e outros equipamentos.
Utilização de técnicas e equipamentos especializados para identificar e reparar vazamentos de gás, garantindo a segurança.
Execução de testes para verificar a segurança, a ausência de vazamentos e a eficiência das instalações de gás e hidráulicas.
Realização de manutenção de primeiro nível em máquinas e equipamentos utilizados durante os serviços.
Preparação e organização do local de trabalho, garantindo o cumprimento de procedimentos e normas regulamentadoras de saúde, segurança no trabalho e meio ambiente.
Local de atuação: Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro
Horário: Temos 2 modelos de jornadas, 44 horas semanais (Segunda a Sexta) e Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno e Noturno).
Requisitos
O que precisamos que você tenha:
Experiência comprovada como Bombeiro Hidráulico/Encanador.
Conhecimento e experiência na instalação e manutenção de sistemas de gás (Gasista).
Curso de Encanador e Bombeiro Hidráulico (ou formação técnica equivalente).
Curso de Gasista.
Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de projetos hidráulicos e de sistemas de gás.
Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis à instalações hidráulicas, sanitárias e de gás.
Comprometimento com a segurança e com as normas regulamentadoras (NRs).
O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver
Proatividade e capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma autônoma.
Experiência em soldagem (cobre, aço).
Certificações adicionais na área de segurança ou manutenção de equipamentos.
Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma clara.
Benefícios
Benefícios
Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.
Seguro de vida: Garante a segurança financeira da sua família em caso de imprevistos, proporcionando tranquilidade e proteção.

title: Consultor Sr/Analista Fiscal Sr
description:
Há mais de uma década, uma jornada de sucesso vem sendo construída com dedicação e excelência no mercado. A MCS Markup completou 11 anos de atuação, reunindo mais de 400 profissionais talentosos distribuídos por todo o Brasil.
Nosso compromisso vai além da entrega de serviços de alta qualidade nas áreas de auditoria, contabilidade e consultoria tributária, contábil e financeira. Somos também uma Empresa Cidadã, que acredita e pratica o equilíbrio entre a vida pessoal e profissional, refletido em ações concretas, como a extensão da licença-maternidade e paternidade.
Na MCS Markup, o trabalho é mais do que cumprir tarefas; é uma jornada de crescimento e aprendizado constante. Se você deseja fazer parte de um time que valoriza seu desenvolvimento, que enxerga além dos números e busca impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas, então seu lugar é aqui.
Junte-se a nós e faça parte do time MCS Markup, onde as oportunidades se entrelaçam com a paixão por um trabalho bem-feito. Sua carreira está esperando por você - venha fazer história conosco
Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.
Sobre a vaga:
Buscamos Consultor Sr (TAX) / Analista Fiscal Sr, para atuar alocado em cliente no Centro - RJ.
Requisitos e qualificações
O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:
Graduação concluída em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
Conhecimento no pacote office, com ênfase em Excel;
Vivência na área de tributos diretos e indiretos.
Principais Atividades
Revisar a apuração do IR/CS junto a equipe de diretos e contabilidade da empresa;
Revisar a apuração PIS/COFINS junto a equipe de diretos e contabilidade da empresa;
Revisar o processo de tomada de créditos de PIS/COFINS junto com o time de suprimentos tanto na contratação de serviços quanto na importação de materiais;
Revisar o processo de escrituração dos documentos fiscais de materiais, transporte e serviços que é performado pela equipe de indiretos da empresa, identificando gaps de - processo e oportunidades de melhoria;
Revisar a apuração dos tributos estaduais e municipais (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS e retidos);
Revisar as entregas das obrigações fiscais principais e acessórias;
Acompanhar o atendimento da empresa em eventuais fiscalizações federais, estaduais e municipais;
Revisar o cumprimento das Obrigações Acessórias e Apurações Fiscais;
Revisão dos arquivos EFD-Contribuições, EFD-ICMS/IPI, GIA, DIPAM, DCTF, DCTFWeb; DIRF, ECF e REINF;
Realizar o cruzamento das obrigações Sped Fiscal vs EFD contribuições, Sped-Fiscal vs ECD, ECD vs ECF, entre outras;
Atuar no escopo de Planejamento Tributário com os departamentos internos da empresa no tocante ao REPETRO, por meio da revisão dos controles existes e identificação de melhorias, suprimentos e operações, variações contratuais, desenho fiscal da operação da empresa, novos contratos;
Alinhamento com os departamentos tributários das empresas acionistas;
Alinhamento do plano de implementação da Reforma Tributária com a equipe da empresa.
O que oferecemos:
Contratação Temporária;
Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
Seguro de Vida;
VR/VA;
Vale Transporte;
Wellhub (Gympass);
Parcerias em Instituições de Ensino e idiomas;
Plataforma de Gestão de Saúde Emocional;
Day off no seu aniversário;
Vale Presente de Aniversário:
Universidade Corporativa.
Etapas do processo:
Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos; Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.
Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta fase, mergulharemos no seu conhecimento técnico para avaliar as habilidades e competências essenciais para a posição.
Retorno do processo: Independentemente do resultado, iremos comunicá-lo a você e discutir os próximos passos.

title: Front End Architect
description:
Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. With offices in Boston, Montreal, Los Angeles, Quito, and hubs across the Americas, we partner with marketing and technology leaders to deliver personalized web, mobile, and ecommerce solutions that elevate customer experiences.
At Verndale, we thrive on collaboration and innovation, offering a full range of services that span strategy, design, development, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital advertising. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, striving to create a climate of respect essential for both individual and company success.
If you're ready to be part of a passionate team dedicated to making an impact and driving growth, we invite you to explore a career at Verndale.
About The Role
The Front-End Architect role is a mix of technical adviser, team leader, coder, and evangelist. On a project the Front-End Architect is responsible for all front-end tasks including estimation, requirements gathering, advising, overseeing other developers, and directing the implementation. Within the department the Front End Architect works with the Director of Front End and other Architects to push the team towards the latest tools, technologies, and best practices. Strong technical ability in HTML, CSS and JavaScript and effective organization and communication skills is a must.
Responsibilities
Be capable of taking on any size and complexity of project.
Be able to manage multiple projects and responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
Work closely with other departments, team members, vendors, and clients
Collaborate with experience architects to validate prototypes meet conditions of the project and suggest improvements or changes as needed.
Collaborate with experience designers to validate designs meet conditions of the project and suggest improvements or changes as needed.
Collaborate with technical architects and back-end engineers to determine technical requirements and implementation approaches for the project.
Work with clients to define and understand requirements and to resolve issues or questions during development.
Work with vendors to understand their systems and integrations and how it will impact our projects.
Estimation:
Continually update front end estimates throughout the project life cycle.
Capture and continually update all assumptions used to create estimations.
Team Oversight
Oversee and mentor front end engineers on the project.
Conduct code reviews and provide feedback and guidance to developers based on the code.
Assign out tasks to team members effectively.
Manage team members - this includes 1:1's as well as career paths, quarterly reviews and performance reviews.
Department Contributions
Evaluate frameworks, technologies and tools and determine their relevance to a particular project or the wider department.
Help drive department standards and best practices.
Project Responsibilities
Ensure all front-end aspects of projects proceed efficiently, predictably and on time.
Review the statement of work, functional spec, and other documents to understand the project goals and front-end specifics such as: hours sold, timeline, browser support, coding standards, framework requirements, etc.
Participate in requirements gathering and validation.
Create technical documentation for front end aspects of the project.
Identify and raise potential project risks to the team and help to alleviate those risks.
Architect and write front end code for the foundation and complex features of each project and set establish API endpoints.
Perform smoke tests on various devices and browsers.
Qualifications
At least 5 or more years of software development experience using an object oriented programming language, preferably Javascript, but other backgrounds are considered.
At least 3 or more years of experience creating responsive experiences using SASS/LESS/PostCSS and semantic HTML5.
At least 2 to 3 years' experience leading a team of engineers on mid to large scale projects.
Strong development fundamentals including clean, reusable code.
Strong Expertise with front-end technologies: JavaScript (ES6), React, Webpack, Babel, HTML5, CSS/SASS
At least 1 year of working with an Agile/SCRUM workflow.
At least 1 year experience using Git and git-flow.
Agency experience
Attention to detail. Be able to replicate provided designs and meet all functional requirements of the project.
Nice to Have
At least 2 to 3 years of professional Javascript MVC experience using any library - high preference towards React.
GraphQL
Tailwind and/or Bootstrap experience
NextJS
NodeJS
Platform expertise: XMCloud, WordPress, Webflow, Opti SaaS.
Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale
We are a rapidly growing company that is just as scrappy and entrepreneurial today as when we were founded in 1998.
We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients' complex business problems through technology, data, and design.
We foster a culture that enables every person in the organization to do the best work of their career.
We offer regular training and professional development to move careers forward.
Client and employee satisfaction are our two most important business metrics.
We celebrate and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion.
We offer generous paid company holidays, vacation, and paid sick time to every employee starting on day one.
We offer top-of-the-line Health Insurance, plus monthly perks customized to meet individual employees' needs.
We support a healthy work/life balance.
We are fully remote enabled and embrace the evolving definition of the workplace

Venha fazer parte de uma das mais sólidas e conceituadas empresas brasileiras do mercado de mobiliário residencial e corporativo. Fundada em 1980, a Novo Ambiente oferece há mais de 30 anos o que há de mais especial no design mundial para lares, empresas e áreas de convivência em todo o Brasil, representando marcas icônicas e reconhecidas internacionalmente.
Buscamos uma pessoa organizada, proativa e comprometida, que atue de maneira versátil nas rotinas administrativas/financeiras. Se você se identificou com as atividades, essa oportunidade é para você

SOBRE A NOSSA OPORTUNIDADE
Nosso time financeiro é peça-chave para garantir que a operação da empresa funcione de forma fluida e eficiente. Buscamos uma pessoa organizada, responsável e atenta a detalhes, que atue de forma estruturada nas rotinas financeiras, assegurando o correto controle de pagamentos, documentos fiscais e informações no sistema.
COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA POR AQUI
Executar e controlar a rotina de contas a pagar, incluindo lançamentos, programação e acompanhamento de pagamentos;
Conferir e validar notas fiscais, boletos e contratos, garantindo conformidade fiscal e financeira;

Acompanhar vencimentos, fluxo de pagamentos e conciliações financeiras;
Apoiar o processo de fechamento mensal, organização de documentos e controle de pendências;
Manter contato com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço para esclarecimentos e alinhamentos;
Atualizar planilhas de controle e relatórios financeiros;
Garantir a correta organização e arquivamento da documentação financeira e fiscal.
VOCÊ PRECISA TER
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência anterior com rotinas financeiras, especialmente contas a pagar;
Conhecimento em conferência de documentos fiscais e processos de pagamento;
Domínio de Excel e familiaridade com sistemas de gestão (ERP).
ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ TENHA
Atenção a detalhes e organização;
Responsabilidade e comprometimento com prazos;
Boa comunicação para relacionamento com fornecedores e áreas internas;
Capacidade de controle e acompanhamento de processos.

Quem somos? Design com alma brasileira é mais do que um conceito:é nossa essência. Somos uma marca que, há quase 80 anos, transforma casas em lares. Referência no setor, oferecemos soluções completas para todos os ambientes, unindo tradição, inovação e excelência em cada detalhe. title: Gerente de Planejamento Call Center
description:
Se você é uma pessoa movida por desafios, gosta de aprender coisas novas e deseja fortalecer o seu conhecimento adquirido na graduação, chegou a oportunidade de você colocar esse aprendizado em prática
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Liderar o time de Planejamento (WFM), garantindo a gestão eficiente de forecast, capacity e programação da operação.
Realizar o forecast de volume (ligações, contatos digitais, tickets) com base em dados históricos, sazonalidade e tendências do negócio.
Calcular capacidade operacional (capacity) considerando headcount, absenteísmo, shrinkage, produtividade e metas de SLA.
Desenvolver estratégias para otimização da força de trabalho, garantindo melhor alocação de recursos e redução de custos.
Construir e revisar escalas, jornadas e dimensionamento, garantindo aderência à legislação trabalhista e às necessidades da operação.
Monitorar indicadores de performance (Nível de Serviço, TMA, TME, taxa de abandono, ocupação, backlog), propondo ações corretivas.
Acompanhar em tempo real (RTA) para tomada de decisão rápida em variações de volume ou performance.
Elaborar análises e reports executivos para diretoria, apresentando desempenho, riscos e projeções.
Apoiar na definição de metas operacionais junto à gerência de operações e qualidade.
Implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos de planejamento, utilizando dashboards, metodologias ágeis e automações.
Participar de transições e ramp-ups, garantindo dimensionamento correto e estabilidade operacional.
Realizar interface com áreas internas (Operações, RH, TI, Comercial, Qualidade) alinhando necessidades de capacidade e estratégias.
Acompanhar contratos e acordos de Níveis de Serviço (SLAs) quando houver clientes externos.
Identificar riscos operacionais e desenvolver planos de contingência para picos de demanda ou quedas de performance.
Requisitos e qualificações
Formação
Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Estatística, Economia, Matemática, Gestão de Operações ou áreas correlatas.
Pós-graduação/MBA em Gestão, Analytics, Data Science ou áreas afins (desejável).
Experiência
Experiência sólida em Planejamento/WFM no segmento de Call Center.
Vivência com gestão de equipes de Forecast, Capacity, Scheduling e RTA.
Histórico de atuação com contato direto com operações de atendimento.
Experiência em elaboração de estudos de dimensionamento e projeções de headcount.
Experiência em cenários de ramp-up, novos negócios e operações de grande porte (diferencial).
Conhecimentos Técnicos
Domínio de ferramentas de WFM (ex.: Genesys, Verint, NICE, Teleopti, Invision, CallFlex, Infinity, etc.).
Excel e Google Sheets avançado (PROCV, Tabelas Dinâmicas, Macros).
Conhecimento sólido em análises estatísticas e modelagem de forecast.
Power BI ou ferramentas de BI (desejável).
Forte entendimento de indicadores de call center: SLA, TMA, TME, Nível de Serviço, Occupancy, Abandono, Backlog etc.
Domínio de cálculo de capacity, dimensionamento e escalas.
Conhecimento de legislação trabalhista aplicada às jornadas de trabalho.
Noções de automação (VBA, Python ou SQL) são diferenciais fortes.
Competências Comportamentais
Capacidade analítica e orientação a dados.
Liderança sólida e habilidade para desenvolver pessoas.
Tomada de decisão rápida, com visão estratégica.
Comunicação clara e objetiva.
Organização e gestão de prioridades.
Perfil solucionador de problemas.
Flexibilidade e adaptação a mudanças de demanda.
Capacidade de conduzir reuniões e apresentações executivas.
Diferenciais
Experiência com múltiplos canais (voz, chat, e-mail, redes sociais).
Vivência com operações BPO.
Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou automação no planejamento.
Certificações em WFM, Lean, Six Sigma ou Analytics.

title: Assistant Registrar, Records
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students.
This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.
Supervisory Authority
Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.
Nature And Scope
Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.
Principal Accountabilities
Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including, but not limited to, registration permissions, overrides, waitlist and batch registration.
Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
Produces academic standing and Deans list reports for review by the Provost's Office and
various schools and colleges.
Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
Develops and delivers point-of-use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account
Core Competencies
Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e. Banner, Colleague, Workday).
Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
Detail-oriented and customer service and compliance-focused.
Proven record of accountability and follow-through.
Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar's office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

title: Equipment Inspector
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.
Reports To
Maintenance Superintendent offshore.
Functional relationship with equipment inspection coordinator onshore.
Background
The Equipment Inspector will exhibit high level of knowledge in equipment inspection of boiler, pressure vessels, related systems and accessories. They manage common interfaces that arise in day-to-day operations with the FPSO departments' staff liaising with the Maintenance Superintendent onboard and with the Equipment Inspector Coordinator onshore.
Authority
The Equipment Inspector undertakes regulatory compliance inspections in pressure vessels systems and related instruments / equipments.
Immediate Subordinates
Visitors, subcontractors
Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards
1) Develop And Maintain Effective Working Relationships
1 Establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and visitors to the working environment.
2 Establish and maintain effective communications with colleagues, external visitors and supervisors.
3 Carry out accurate and effective work handovers.
2) Works
1 Conduct internal and external equipment inspection as well as hydro test as required by the regulation.
2 Ensure full compliance with SPIE regulation.
3 Keep all inspection and equipments data book updated.
4 Produce reports of the equipment inspection and its data book.
5 Follow external audits and reports to the Maintenance Superintendent and to the Equipment Inspector Coordinator the status of the audit.
6 Coordination of the subcontractors work on board the unit in regard to the SPIE equipments.
3) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
1 Work area within own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
2 Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
3 Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
4 All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
1 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to Management System guidelines.
2 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are segregated properly and dealt with according to the correct procedure.
5) Emergency Response
1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.
Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies
Offshore - Handover
Offshore - Emergency Response
Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge
Offshore - Global Enterprise Management System
Offshore - Reports
Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding
Offshore - Planning Work
Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment
Offshore - Safety Management
Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience
Experience as Equipment Inspector and qualified to Equipment Inspection Course.
Proven qualification on NDT and welding.
Experience and knowledge in offshore operation is desirable.
Computer literate on Management System 'Office' software packages.
Proficiency in English at a minimum of A2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: executive chef
description:
Descrição da empresa
Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.
THE HOTEL
Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026.
Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand's contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.
Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.
Descrição da vaga
We are seeking an accomplished Executive Chef to lead our culinary operations, crafting exceptional dining experiences across 7 outlets. This is a unique opportunity to shape the gastronomic vision of a landmark property, managing a high-performing team and delivering world-class cuisine in a dynamic luxury environment.
Key Roles & Responsibilities
Lead all culinary operations from pre-opening through ongoing hotel operations, establishing the kitchen's structure, standards, and workflows;
Design and refine innovative menus and recipes, ensuring alignment with brand standards and guest expectations;
Train and mentor the kitchen team, nurturing their growth and passion while upholding the brand's signature standards of refinement and innovation;
Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and culinary excellence;
Implement and enforce rigorous food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards, fully compliant with HACCP and local regulations;
Maintain quality control processes to ensure food freshness, consistency, presentation, and adherence to hygiene standards;
Manage food inventory, control costs, approve purchase orders, and operate within the established budget;
Conduct regular performance appraisals, provide constructive feedback, and support ongoing professional development of the team;
Develop and maintain departmental operations manuals and training programs to ensure consistent standards, compliance, and continuous improvement;
Monitor guest feedback, adapting offerings and service to uphold Sofitel's luxury culinary experience.
Qualificações
Bachelor's degree in Culinary with advanced certifications;
10+ years leading high-end kitchens in luxury hotels or fine dining establishments, with proven experience managing large, talented teams;
Mastery of international and French cuisine, menu innovation, and flawless food presentation;
Expertise in cost control, budgeting, inventory management, and operational efficiency;
Deep knowledge of food safety, sanitation, and compliance standards;
Exceptional leadership, mentoring, and team-building skills; thrives under pressure in fast-paced luxury environments;
Passion for creating unforgettable dining experiences with the highest standards of quality, creativity, and innovation;
Commitment to cultivating a positive kitchen culture and introducing signature and seasonal concepts that define the hotel's culinary identity;
Fluent in Portuguese, English and French with excellent communication skills.

title: Pessoa Consultora Responsável
description:
Descrição da vaga
SOBRE O GRUPO BOTICÁRIO
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil e Linha de cuidados Pampers, e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores forma o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.
CONHEÇA O VAREJO DO GRUPO BOTICÁRIO
Essa é uma oportunidade para fazer parte da Melhor Empresa para se trabalhar no Varejo, segundo o ranking do Glassdoor 2025 Acreditamos que a beleza vai além dos produtos e se manifesta na conexão das nossas histórias e na criação de experiências inesquecíveis, afinal somos a empresa mais presenteável do Brasil e garantimos o brilho no olho dos nossos clientes. Este é o varejo próprio do Grupo Boticário: uma potência com mais de 4 mil lojas e uma presença em 99,9% do território brasileiro, onde milhares de pessoas transformam vidas todos os dias por meio da beleza.
Buscamos uma pessoa consultora de loja, com disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente, que seja apaixonada pelo universo da beleza, cosméticos e autocuidado, assim como nós. Queremos conhecer você para construir, juntos, o futuro da beleza
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Seu desafio na loja:
Consultoria de experiência: Responsável pelo encantamento dos nossos clientes, compreendendo suas necessidades (seja um presente especial, um autocuidado ou um lançamento inovador) para oferecer a solução perfeita.
Foco em vendas: apresentar produtos de forma envolvente, bater metas e impulsionar os resultados da loja, sempre com excelência no atendimento.
Cuidado com a loja: Auxílio na abertura e fechamento da loja, além de cuidar da organização e reposição da loja, garantindo que o ambiente esteja sempre inspirador e acolhedor.
Adorar aprender: participar ativamente dos nossos treinamentos de produto, técnicas de venda e desenvolvimento pessoal.
Requisitos e qualificações
O que você buscamos em você:
Ensino médio completo;
Experiência na área comercial sendo desejável vivência em lojas de varejo;
Habilidade com maquiagem e conhecimento em produtos de beleza será um diferencial;
Habilidade no digital e familiaridade com sistemas;
Disponibilidade para atuar das 10h ás 18h - escala 6x1.
Informações adicionais
O cuidado é a nossa essência Por isso, garantimos que você tenha benefícios diferenciados: um portfólio com mais de 20 opções, pensado para zelar pela sua saúde, bem-estar e de toda a sua família.

De uma pequena farmácia de manipulação à maior franquia de cosméticos do planeta.
Somos um Grupo com 15 marcas que está presente em mais de 40 países, com mais de 4 mil lojas físicas, líder de e-commerce de beleza no Brasil e mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos. Temos um ecossistema próprio de beleza, que vai da indústria ao ponto de venda, da logística ao varejo, do laboratório ao coração das consumidoras e das nossas inovações na palma da sua mão. Acreditamos que o futuro mais bonito é aquele que construímos juntos, por isso, até 2030 temos compromissos ambiciosos voltados para o impacto positivo em dimensões humanas, ambientais e em nossos processos produtivos.
Ganhamos o ranking "Employer Branding Awards 2025" do Glassdoor, que nos elegeu a melhor empresa para se trabalhar no setor de varejo no Brasil Reconhecimento baseado em avaliações voluntárias e anônimas de nossos colaboradores e ex-colaboradores sobre como é trabalhar aqui.
Reinventamos a beleza por meio da tecnologia, inovação, diversidade e sustentabilidade com: O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuarmos com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil e Linha de cuidados Pampers.

Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em .NET / C#.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.
The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.
We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
Act as the volunteer department's main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA's data protection standards.
Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct "Train-the-Trainer" sessions for system users.
Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
Education: Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
Training delivery experience a plus
Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
Team player with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Parceria pioneira com o SESC com o espaço SESC + SAÚDE, oferecendo serviços gratuitos de odontologia e saúde da mulher (preventivo e mamografia) aos nossos funcionários.
SOBRE NÓS
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

title: Banco de Talentos: Oficial de Manutenção
description:
Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro.
Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado(a) futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.
Na Smart Hospital, acreditamos que a diversidade nos torna mais fortes. Nossas oportunidades são abertas a todos os talentos, com foco total na inclusão de pessoa com deficiência PCD e reabilitados pelo INSS.
Quem somos?
Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.
O que buscamos?
Estamos buscamos profissionais talentosos e experientes para nosso Banco de Talentos de Oficial de Manutenção. O objetivo é identificar e ter em nosso cadastro candidatos com sólido conhecimento em manutenção predial em geral, com experiência em um ou mais ofícios (como alvenaria, pintura, marcenaria, serralheria, etc.), preferencialmente em ambientes hospitalares. Você será um profissional essencial na manutenção da infraestrutura, garantindo a funcionalidade, segurança e estética das nossas instalações.
Dia a Dia
O profissional selecionado para vagas futuras poderá exercer atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva que envolvam:
Pintura: Preparar superfícies, aplicar tintas, massas, vernizes e outros produtos de acabamento.
Alvenaria e Acabamentos: Assentar tijolos, blocos, reboco, pisos, azulejos e outros revestimentos. Realizar reparos civis em telhados, lajes e calçadas.
Marcenaria: Analisar, confeccionar e reparar móveis e peças, trabalhando a madeira, armando partes e finalizando acabamentos.
Serralheria: Interpretar desenhos, realizar cortes em metais, aplicar técnicas de soldagem, modelar e montar estruturas metálicas, corrimões e grades.
Geral: Realizar pequenos reparos de alvenaria, hidráulica (simples) e elétrica (simples), e consertos de rachaduras e buracos. Organizar, limpar e manter o local de trabalho seguro. Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança no local de trabalho (incluindo o uso de EPIs) e procedimentos hospitalares. Auxiliar em outras tarefas de manutenção predial conforme a necessidade.
Local de trabalho: Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro
Horário: Temos 2 modelos de jornadas, 44 horas semanais (Segunda a Sexta) e Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno e Noturno).
Requisitos
O que precisamos que você tenha:
Escolaridade: Ensino Fundamental Completo ou Segundo Grau Completo (dependendo da especialidade da vaga).
Experiência: Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência comprovada ou curso profissionalizante em uma das áreas de manutenção (Pintura, Marcenaria, Serralheria ou Alvenaria/Pedreiro).
Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento sólido nas técnicas do ofício principal (leitura de desenho técnico, soldagem, uso de ferramentas e equipamentos, etc.).
Habilitação Profissional (quando aplicável ao ofício).
O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver
Fortes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe.
Proatividade e iniciativa para antecipar problemas e buscar soluções de forma autônoma.
Certificação ou treinamento em segurança ocupacional (NRs como a NR-35 - Trabalho em Altura, por exemplo) será considerado um diferencial.
Conhecimento prático de normas de segurança no local de trabalho.
Experiência prévia em manutenção predial em hospitais ou ambientes de saúde.
Benefícios
Benefícios
Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico Odontoprev e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Hi there We are South and our client is looking for a Senior Account Manager / Account Director
Note To Applicants
Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.
Note: If you're hired for this role, you may be asked to update your LinkedIn profile :)
About The Role
We are a fast-growing, highly specialized digital marketing agency serving dental practices across the United States. Our clients invest seriously in marketing and expect clarity, confidence, and results — especially when challenges arise.We are hiring a Senior Account Manager / Account Director to strengthen our senior client leadership layer. This role exists to provide calm, structure, and decisive ownership across complex accounts, and to act as a trusted escalation point when issues exceed day-to-day account management.This is a senior, judgment-heavy role. The right person has already handled demanding clients, managed internal complexity, and taken responsibility for fixing problems — not just reporting on them.Depending on experience and demonstrated capability, this role may operate closer to a Senior Account Manager or a full Account Director level.What You'll Own
Senior Client Leadership & Escalation
Act as a primary escalation point for complex or sensitive client issues
Lead difficult conversations with confidence and emotional intelligence
Reset expectations, de-escalate tension, and reestablish trust when needed
Proactively identify accounts at risk and intervene before problems escalate
Account Oversight & Organization
Oversee a portfolio of accounts with a focus on organization, follow-through, and accountability
Ensure client requests, deliverables, and internal actions are clearly tracked and prioritized
Coordinate across Paid Media, SEO, Tracking, and Operations teams to resolve blockers
Bring structure to ambiguity and order to fast-moving situations
Strategic Communication (Not Channel Execution)
Understand campaign performance well enough to speak credibly and clearly with clients
Translate technical or operational issues into plain, confident client-facing explanations
Help clients understand why something is happening and what the plan is to fix it
Identify opportunities to expand or deepen relationships when appropriate
Internal Leadership & Judgment
Know when to escalate — and when not to
Make sound judgment calls without waiting for constant approval
Support and guide junior AMs through complex situations
Surface recurring issues and help improve internal processes over time
Leveling & Scope ExpectationsWe are open to hiring at different points within this senior range, based on experience and demonstrated ownership:Senior Account Manager–Level Candidates
Independently manage complex accounts with minimal oversight
Confidently handle escalations but may involve leadership for higher-risk situations
Strong organizers and communicators who bring consistency and reliability
Account Director–Level Candidates
Operate as a true stabilizing force across high-value or high-risk accounts
Own escalations end-to-end with little to no leadership involvement
Trusted to make judgment calls that protect retention and long-term relationships
Naturally operate as a mentor and senior presence within the AM team
Compensation within the range reflects where a candidate operates across this spectrum.What We're Looking For
Required Experience
5–8+ years in a senior Account Manager or Account Director role at a digital marketing agency
Direct experience managing U.S.-based clients
Proven ownership of escalations, renewals, and retention
Comfort working across Paid Media, SEO, and performance marketing environments
Experience coordinating multiple internal teams simultaneously
Communication & Presence
Near-perfect spoken and written English (non-negotiable)
Confident, composed presence on Zoom and client calls
Able to push back diplomatically and set boundaries when needed
Trusted quickly by senior decision-makers
Personal Traits
Highly organized; systems-oriented, not reactive
Calm under pressure; emotionally mature
Naturally proactive — sees issues before they explode
Takes ownership rather than deferring responsibility
Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, evolving environment

title: Associate Director, Clinical Biomarkers
description:
Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine's next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.
The Position
The Associate Director of Clinical Biomarkers will play a pivotal role in advancing biomarker strategies to support the clinical development of Nurix's innovative therapies targeting protein homeostasis. As a leader in the Clinical Biomarkers team, the successful candidate will collaborate across research, clinical development, and external partnerships to drive the biomarker strategy for early phase clinical trials. This role involves leading the design, execution, and interpretation of biomarker assays. These efforts will contribute to patient selection, pharmacodynamic assessments, and the elucidation of drug mechanisms of action.
Specific Responsibilities Include
Lead the development, validation, and execution of clinical biomarker strategies to inform patient stratification, response prediction, and resistance mechanisms across Nurix's clinical programs.
Leverage deep expertise in cell and tumor biology, molecular biology, inflammation and immuno-oncology to design and interpret both preclinical and clinical biomarker studies.
Oversee biomarker assay development, including assay qualification and execution on diverse platforms, to support pharmacodynamic and predictive biomarker analysis in clinical trials.
Lead the evaluation and implementation of novel biomarker assays in both nonclinical models and patient-derived samples, ensuring alignment with clinical trial objectives.
Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams, including research scientists, clinical development, external collaborators, and contract research organizations (CROs), to ensure seamless integration of biomarker data into clinical development plans.
Provide scientific and strategic input into clinical trial designs, ensuring biomarker data are effectively utilized to guide therapeutic decisions and optimize patient outcomes.
Mentor and manage junior scientists, fostering a collaborative and innovative research environment.
Demonstrate strong motivation, creativity, and teamwork, with excellent time management and organizational skills.
Education And Skills Requirements
Advanced degree (M.S, Ph.D. preferred) with 8+ years of experience in a relevant scientific area within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry; candidates with a strong translational biomarker background in Immunology, Oncology, or Hematology are preferred.
Proven expertise in the development, qualification, and implementation of clinical biomarker assays, particularly in the areas of inflammation, immuno-oncology, cancer biology, or related therapeutic areas.
Extensive technical experience across diverse platforms, including flow cytometry, molecular biology, proteomics, and tissue-based assays; hands-on experience with clinical samples is a plus.
Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional teams, with a track record of integrating biomarker data to influence clinical decision-making.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex biomarker data to both scientific and clinical audiences, as well as external stakeholders.

Knowledge of Juniper, Cisco, Dell, Aruba, and Siena switches.

Experience with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.
Understanding of SD-WAN concepts and operation.

Operating Systems:
Proficiency in Linux, including command execution, service verification, and log analysis.
Knowledge of Apache and MySQL.
Certifications:
LPI or vendor technical certifications (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Dell, Aruba, etc.).
Languages:
Advanced English for verbal and written communication, technical documentation reading, and vendor interaction.
